# Quarter Collection

_SKOS collection in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Quarter, the Quarter Cluster and three of its five parts, listed flat. Two parts are absent and one member belongs to the month rather than the quarter, which is the copy this collection was made from showing through. The hierarchy under Quarter Cluster is authoritative.
